acceptanceCriteria: The general profile model preserves stable identity, ordered entries, optional groups, repeated entries, transposition, preferred-timbre identifiers, and duplicate display names.
The platform-neutral library safely creates, replaces, duplicates, reorders, removes, and restores profiles with arbitrary practical entry counts; it does not start playback.

Versioned local persistence provides deterministic legacy migration, atomic autosave, last-valid snapshots, corrupt-store preservation and recovery, explicit reset, and backup-eligible caller-selected placement.
The foundation is local-only and has no account, cloud database, analytics, runtime network, microphone, iPhone authoring UI, catalog content, or Watch synchronization transport.
componentsAffected: Platform-neutral profile, ordered-entry, grouping, metadata, transposition, preferred-timbre, and stable-identity models.
Versioned iPhone-local persistence, atomic autosave, snapshots, migration, corrupt-store recovery, reset, and backup-eligible placement.
notes: No iPhone authoring or browsing presentation, Watch synchronization transport, cloud service, account, analytics, network access, microphone behavior, or automatic playback.
rationale: The product must serve a multi-instrument musician without hard-coded instrument assumptions.
testSteps: Record deterministic validation, lifecycle, migration, local-only, recovery, and reset results; keep UI-only and physical-device verification separate.

workItem.title: Build tuning profiles and local persistence
